name: How long does wood siding typically last in the Bay Area climate?

mainEntity.name: How long does wood siding typically last in the Bay Area climate?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of wood siding in the Bay Area can vary significantly depending on the type of wood, quality of installation, and regular maintenance. Generally, well-maintained wood siding can last 20-40 years or more. However, the coastal proximity in areas like Pacifica and Daly City can expose siding to increased moisture and salt, potentially accelerating wear. Regular inspections and timely repairs are crucial for maximizing its longevity in these conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wood siding typically lasts 20-40 years in the Bay Area, but coastal exposure can affect its lifespan. Regular maintenance is key.
